kunyomi: すす・む / すす・める
words:
進[すす]む — to advance, progress — अगाडि बढ्नु
進[すす]める — to advance (tr.), proceed with — अगाडि बढाउनु
進歩[しんぽ] — progress — प्रगति
進学[しんがく] — going on to higher education — माथिल्लो पढाइमा जानु
example: 工事[こうじ]は 予定[よてい]どおり 進[すす]んでいる。
example_en: The construction is progressing as scheduled.
example_ne: निर्माण कार्य तालिकाअनुसार अगाडि बढिरहेको छ।
component: 辶 + 隹 (a bird moving forward on a path → advance, progress)
confusable: 準 (じゅん, 準備) also contains 隹
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day9 verb

words:
友達[ともだち] — friend — साथी
達成[たっせい] — achievement — प्राप्ति
配達[はいたつ] — delivery — डेलिभरी
上達[じょうたつ] — improvement (of a skill) — सीपमा सुधार
example: 毎日[まいにち] 練習[れんしゅう]すれば 日本語[にほんご]が 上達[じょうたつ]する。
example_en: If you practice every day, your Japanese will improve.
example_ne: हरेक दिन अभ्यास गरे जापानी भाषा सुध्रिन्छ।
component: 辶 + 幸 (advancing along the road to find good fortune → reach, attain)
confusable: 違 (ちが・う) = 辶 + 韋 — nearly identical at a glance
disc_front: Which kanji is in 友達 (friend)? 友＿
disc_note: 達 has 土 over 羊 on the right. 違 has 韋 with a 口 in the middle (違う, 間違い). 建 uses 廴, not 辶.
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day9 noun confusable

kunyomi: つた・える / つた・わる
words:
伝[つた]える — to convey, tell — बताउनु, सन्देश दिनु
伝[つた]わる — to be conveyed, get across — पुग्नु (सन्देश)
手伝[てつだ]う — to help — सघाउनु
伝統[でんとう] — tradition — परम्परा
伝言[でんごん] — message (verbal) — सन्देश
example: 田中[たなか]さんに よろしく 伝[つた]えてください。
example_en: Please give my regards to Tanaka.
component: 亻 + 云 (a person speaking words to pass them along → convey, transmit)
confusable: 会 (あ・う) = 人 + 云; 転 (てん) reads the same in 運転
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day9 verb

words:
守[まも]る — to protect; to keep (a rule/promise) — रक्षा गर्नु, पालना गर्नु
留守[るす] — absence from home — घरमा नहुनु
留守番[るすばん] — house-sitting; answering machine — घर कुर्ने
見守[みまも]る — to watch over — हेरचाह गर्नु
example: 約束[やくそく]は 必[かなら]ず 守[まも]ってください。
example_en: Please always keep your promises.
component: 宀 + 寸 (a hand guarding under a roof → protect, keep)
confusable: 字 (じ) = 宀 + 子; 宇 (う, 宇宙) = 宀 + 于
disc_front: Which kanji means 'protect / keep'? 約束を＿る
disc_note: 守 has 寸 under the roof. 字 has 子 (character, 漢字). 宇 has 于 (宇宙).
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day9 verb confusable

words:
求[もと]める — to seek, request, demand — खोज्नु, माग गर्नु
要求[ようきゅう] — demand — माग
求人[きゅうじん] — job offer, recruitment — रोजगार विज्ञापन
追求[ついきゅう] — pursuit — खोजी
example: 会社[かいしゃ]は 社員[しゃいん]に 高[たか]い 能力[のうりょく]を 求[もと]めている。
example_en: The company seeks high ability from its employees.
example_ne: कम्पनीले कर्मचारीबाट उच्च क्षमता खोजिरहेको छ।
component: 十 + 氺 (reaching out in all directions to find what is needed → seek, request)
confusable: 球 (たま, ball) = 王 + 求; 救 (すく・う, save) = 求 + 攵
disc_front: Which kanji means 'seek / demand'? 能力を＿めている
disc_note: 求 stands alone. 球 has 王 on the left (野球). 救 has 攵 on the right (救急車).
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day9 verb confusable

words:
与[あた]える — to give, grant; to cause (influence) — दिनु, पार्नु
給与[きゅうよ] — salary, pay — तलब
関与[かんよ] — involvement — संलग्नता
example: 子供[こども]に 悪[わる]い 影響[えいきょう]を 与[あた]えてはいけない。
example_en: You must not have a bad influence on children.
component: simplified from 與 (hands lifting up an offering to give)
confusable: 写 (うつ・す, copy) — 写 has 冖 on top, 与 does not
disc_front: Which kanji means 'give'? 影響を＿える
disc_note: 与 has no top cover. 写 has 冖 on top (写真). 号 has 口 on top (番号).
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day10 verb confusable

kunyomi: う・ける / う・かる
words:
受[う]ける — to receive; to take (an exam) — पाउनु, (परीक्षा) दिनु
受[う]かる — to pass (an exam) — पास हुनु
受付[うけつけ] — reception — रिसेप्सन
受験[じゅけん] — taking an exam — परीक्षा दिनु
受[う]け 取[と]る — to receive, accept — प्राप्त गर्नु
example: 十二月[じゅうにがつ]に N3を 受[う]けるつもりだ。
example_en: I plan to take N3 in December.
component: 爫 + 冖 + 又 (a hand above passing an item down to a hand below to receive it)
confusable: 授 (さず・ける, 授業) = 扌 + 受
disc_front: Which kanji means 'receive'? 試験を＿ける
disc_note: 受 stands alone. 授 adds 扌 — giving (授業). 愛 has 心 in the middle — love.
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day10 verb confusable

words:
得[え]る — to gain, obtain — प्राप्त गर्नु
得意[とくい] — good at; forte — सिपालु
納得[なっとく] — being convinced, accepting — चित्त बुझ्नु
損得[そんとく] — profit and loss — नाफा-घाटा
〜せざるを 得[え]ない — cannot help but — नगरी सुखै छैन
example: 彼[かれ]の 説明[せつめい]には 納得[なっとく]できない。
example_en: I can't accept his explanation.
component: 彳 + 日 + 寸 (walking along a path and picking up a treasure with your hand to gain it)
confusable: 特 (とく, 特別) = 牛 + 寺 — same reading; 待 (ま・つ) = 彳 + 寺
disc_front: Which kanji is in 納得 (convinced)? 納＿
disc_note: 得 has 彳 with 日 + 寸 on the right. 特 has 牛 on the left (特別). 待 has 彳 but 寺 on the right (待つ).
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day10 verb noun confusable

words:
取[と]る — to take, get — लिनु
受[う]け 取[と]る — to receive — प्राप्त गर्नु
取[と]り 消[け]す — to cancel — रद्द गर्नु
取[と]り 出[だ]す — to take out — निकाल्नु
取材[しゅざい] — news gathering, interview — रिपोर्टिङ
example: 予約[よやく]を 取[と]り 消[け]したいのですが。
example_en: I'd like to cancel my reservation.
component: 耳 + 又 (a hand taking an ear as a war trophy)
confusable: 最 (もっと・も) = 日 + 取; 趣 (しゅ, 趣味) = 走 + 取
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day10 verb

kunyomi: に・げる / に・がす / のが・す
words:
逃[に]げる — to run away, escape — भाग्नु
逃[に]がす — to let escape, set free — भाग्न दिनु
見逃[みのが]す — to overlook, miss — छुटाउनु
example: 泥棒[どろぼう]は 窓[まど]から 逃[に]げた。

component: 辶 + 兆 (seeing an ominous sign and running along the road to escape)
confusable: 桃 (もも, peach) = 木 + 兆; 挑 (いど・む, 挑戦) = 扌 + 兆
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day10 verb

kunyomi: お・ちる / お・とす
words:
落[お]ちる — to fall; to fail (an exam) — खस्नु; फेल हुनु
落[お]とす — to drop; to lose — खसाल्नु, हराउनु
落[お]ち 着[つ]く — to calm down, settle — शान्त हुनु
落[お]ち 込[こ]む — to feel down — निराश हुनु
example: 財布[さいふ]を どこかで 落[お]としてしまった。
example_en: I dropped my wallet somewhere.
component: 艹 + 氵 + 各 (autumn leaves and water drops falling down one by each)
confusable: 薬 (くすり) also has 艹 on top; 路 (みち) = 足 + 各
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day11 verb

words:
失[うしな]う — to lose — गुमाउनु
失敗[しっぱい] — failure — असफलता
失礼[しつれい] — rudeness; excuse me — अशिष्टता; माफ गर्नुहोस्
失業[しつぎょう] — unemployment — बेरोजगारी
example: 失敗[しっぱい]を 恐[おそ]れずに 挑戦[ちょうせん]しよう。
example_en: Let's take on the challenge without fearing failure.
component: 丿 + 夫 (an item slipping away from an outstretched hand, causing you to lose it)
confusable: 矢 (や, arrow); 夫 (おっと, husband)

disc_note: 失 has an extra stroke poking out at the top-left. 矢 (arrow) has a short flat top. 夫 is 大 with two horizontal lines.
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day11 verb confusable

kunyomi: のこ・る / のこ・す
words:
残[のこ]る — to remain, be left — बाँकी रहनु
残[のこ]す — to leave behind — बाँकी राख्नु

残業[ざんぎょう] — overtime — ओभरटाइम

confusable: 浅 (あさ・い, shallow) = 氵 + 戔; 銭 (ぜに, money) = 金 + 戔

disc_note: 残 has 歹 on the left. 浅 has 氵 (浅い). 銭 has 金 (small change).
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day11 verb confusable

words:
消[き]える — to disappear, go out — हराउनु, निभ्नु
消[け]す — to erase, turn off — मेटाउनु, निभाउनु
消費[しょうひ] — consumption — उपभोग
消防[しょうぼう] — fire fighting — दमकल
取[と]り 消[け]す — to cancel — रद्द गर्नु
example: 出[で]かける 前[まえ]に 電気[でんき]を 消[け]してください。
example_en: Please turn off the lights before going out.

confusable: 削 (けず・る, shave) = 肖 + 刂
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day11 verb

kunyomi: うつ・る / うつ・す
words:
移[うつ]る — to move, shift (intr.) — सर्नु
移[うつ]す — to move, transfer (tr.) — सार्नु
移動[いどう] — movement, transfer — स्थानान्तरण
移民[いみん] — immigrant, immigration — आप्रवासी
example: 来月[らいげつ] 新[あたら]しい オフィスに 移[うつ]る。
example_en: We'll move to a new office next month.
component: 禾 + 多 (carrying many stalks of grain to transfer them to a new field)
confusable: 秒 (びょう, second) = 禾 + 少
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day11 verb

words:
参加[さんか] — participation — सहभागिता
参考[さんこう] — reference — सन्दर्भ
参[まい]る — to go / come (humble) — जानु / आउनु (विनम्र)
example: 来週[らいしゅう]の 会議[かいぎ]に 参加[さんか]します。

kunyomi: くわ・える / くわ・わる

加[くわ]える — to add — थप्नु
加[くわ]わる — to join, be added — सामेल हुनु

増加[ぞうか] — increase — वृद्धि
追加[ついか] — addition — थप

words:

お 願[ねが]い — request; please — अनुरोध
願書[がんしょ] — application form — आवेदन फारम
志願[しがん] — application, volunteering — आवेदन
example: 世界[せかい]の 平和[へいわ]を 願[ねが]っている。

望[のぞ]む — to hope for, desire — चाहनु

失望[しつぼう] — disappointment — निराशा

words:

期待[きたい] — expectation — अपेक्षा
時期[じき] — time, season — समय
学期[がっき] — semester — सत्र
期限[きげん] — deadline — म्याद

words:

disc_note: 限 has 阝 on the left. 眼 has 目 (眼鏡). 根 has 木 (根本). All three share 艮.
tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day13 noun verb confusable

words:
制限[せいげん] — restriction — सीमा, प्रतिबन्ध
制度[せいど] — system — प्रणाली
制服[せいふく] — uniform — पोशाक
規制[きせい] — regulation — नियमन

tags: N3 kanji batch2 vocab_linked kanji_day13 noun confusable

words:
規則[きそく] — rule — नियम
規模[きぼ] — scale — आकार

words:

原則[げんそく] — principle — सिद्धान्त
法則[ほうそく] — law (scientific) — नियम (विज्ञान)

商業[しょうぎょう] — commerce — व्यापार

上品[じょうひん] — elegant, refined — शिष्ट
